verdict: The file uses the correct real bl-* tags (bl-notification, bl-notification-card, bl-button) with valid attribute names, but the core toast mechanism is broken: bl-notification renders notifications exclusively from its internal state via addNotification() and never renders slotted children (confirmed in src/components/notification/bl-notification.ts), so the slotted bl-notification-card never appears; the Undo button's @bl-click is Lit syntax left inert in plain HTML; and direct manipulation of card.closed bypasses the correct close-request flow.
